maxConsecutiveFailures.description: Circuit breaker: trip after this many consecutive commit failures. Default: 5.

branch.description: Git branch name for VCS operations. Default: "master".

remote.description: Git remote URL for this watch root.

accessToken.description: Access token override for this watch root. Supports env var substitution (e.g., "${GIT_TOKEN}").
